brand.name: Growlane
brand.tagline: AI products built for real people.
brand.description: Growlane is an AI-native product studio building intelligent software tools — from relationship intelligence to clinical management, developer tooling, and autonomous agents.

hero.headline: Software that thinks with you.
hero.subtext: We build intelligent tools — for clinics, developers, businesses, and people. Every product we ship starts with one question: does this make someone's life meaningfully better?

featured.title: Pairity — Now in Early Access
featured.description: Our first live product. An AI-powered relationship compatibility engine that analyses personalities and communication styles to give couples deep, honest insight. Not astrology — real intelligence.
featured.label: Try Pairity

products.name: Pairity
products.description: AI-powered compatibility analysis. Understands personalities, communication styles, and values to give couples honest insight into their connection.

products.name: NeuroBrowse
products.description: An AI-native desktop browser built on Electron. BYOK model support. Browses, researches, and acts — an agent that understands context, not just commands.

products.name: ClinicOS
products.description: Modern clinic management for Indian doctors. Multi-tenant, offline-first, Electron-based. Appointments, records, billing, and prescriptions in one interface.

products.name: VaultIQ
products.description: Ask anything. Know everything. RAG pipeline over your entire company knowledge — Notion, Drive, Confluence, PDFs. Cited answers. Real-time updates.

products.name: ReplyIQ
products.description: AI customer support agent that actually resolves. Trains on your product, handles WhatsApp and email, resolves 70%+ tickets autonomously.

products.name: Fixora
products.description: AI-powered error monitoring and diagnostics. Watches your production systems, captures errors in real-time, and diagnoses root causes with probable fixes — before users notice.

pillars.title: AI-Native Products
pillars.description: We build software with AI as the foundation, not a bolt-on feature. Every product reasons, adapts, and improves with use.

pillars.title: SaaS & Healthcare
pillars.description: Deep domain software for India's healthcare sector. Multi-tenant, offline-first, built for real constraints of clinics and hospitals.

pillars.title: Developer Tooling
pillars.description: npm libraries, browser extensions, and infrastructure tools that make developers faster. Built in the open, used by the community.

pillars.title: Agentic Systems
pillars.description: Autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines that do real work — from customer support to knowledge retrieval to complex automation.

about.headline: Built by engineers. Obsessed with craft.
paragraphs: Growlane is a small product studio based in Delhi, India. We are a team of engineers and designers who believe software should think with you, not at you.
Every tool we build starts with a real problem. We do not chase trends. We build things that would still matter in ten years.
We are AI-native from the ground up — every product uses intelligence as its core mechanism, not as an afterthought.
